# About Tags

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/about-tags
**Captured:** 2026-08-04 via the Zscaler Help Portal rendered-data endpoint.

---

This is a scoped summary of the current rendered Help article.

The Tags page is used to configure tag data as namespaces, keys, and values.
After all three components are configured, a tag can be assigned to resource
groups.

## Portal surface

The page is under **Policies > Access Control > Segmentation > Tags**.
Administrators can:

- add a namespace;
- select a namespace to display its tag data;
- search for a tag key or value within the selected namespace;
- add a tag;
- show or hide columns;
- list all tags configured for the namespace;
- open Tag Details for an individual key;
- edit or delete a tag; and
- paginate the table.

## Source boundary

This article documents the portal's namespace/key/value model and its use with
resource groups. It does not enumerate the corresponding GraphQL types,
operations, SDK fields, or enforcement semantics.
